message: Give me two ideas for this gap

plan.goal: Generate two candidate ideas for the label-smoothing / perplexity gap.

args.instruction: The gap: label smoothing (e.g., 0.1) hurts perplexity — the model becomes more uncertain and reports worse perplexity — while improving downstream accuracy and BLEU. Generate two candidate ideas that engage with this tension: how to reconcile or exploit the fact that a model that scores worse on perplexity can still be a better model. One idea may improve label smoothing itself (e.g., a variant that keeps perplexity intact), the other may attack the premise (e.g., whether perplexity is even the right evaluation under label smoothing). Ground the ideas in what is actually published where possible.

steps.why: The user asked for two new candidates for the selected gap; generation with two distinct stances fits the request.
